description: Verified exam-focused notes for 27 November 2026 covering power, monetary operations, telecom regulation, biodiversity, science, defence, infrastructure, social policy and Tamil Nadu schemes.

stories.title: Power Ministers’ Conference opens with focus on energy independence and reforms
stories.summary: The Union Ministry of Power began a two-day conference in New Delhi on 27 November, bringing together ministers, officials and regulators from all 28 States and eight Union Territories. The meeting is a Centre-State consultation on energy security, infrastructure and implementation of power-sector reforms; it is not itself a new investment approval.
key_facts: The conference runs on 27–28 November 2026 and is chaired by the Union Power Minister.
India's installed electricity capacity was reported at about 563 GW, with more than 55% from non-fossil sources.
Around 60 GW was added during the preceding 12 months, of which 87% was from non-fossil sources.
The ministry described the power sector as presenting an estimated ₹200 lakh crore investment opportunity over the next two decades.
stories.exam_link: Electricity is in Entry 38 of the Concurrent List, allowing both Parliament and State legislatures to make laws on the subject.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Power — Power Ministers’ Conference begins, 27 November 2026

stories.title: NAVYA 2.0 announced for launch across 100 districts
stories.summary: The Women and Child Development and Skill Development ministries announced that NAVYA 2.0 would be launched in Haridwar on 28 November 2026. The expanded initiative is planned for 100 districts in 24 States and Union Territories and will use the Skill India Digital Hub for enrolment, tracking and certification. As of the edition date, this was a launch announcement, not a completed rollout.
key_facts: NAVYA expands to the 16–25 age group, compared with 16–18 years in the pilot phase.
Its full form is Nurturing Aspirations through Vocational Training for Young Women and Adolescent Girls.
Training will emphasise industry-relevant, new-age and non-traditional job roles.
The Skill India Digital Hub is intended to track registration, attendance, training progress and certification.
stories.exam_link: Skill development is administered at Union level by the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship, while women and child development programmes involve inter-ministerial and State implementation.
stories.source_title: MWCD and MSDE — NAVYA 2.0 launch announcement, 27 November 2026

stories.title: TRAI updates telecom interconnection and Reference Interconnect Offer rules
stories.summary: TRAI issued the Telecommunication Interconnection (Reference Interconnect Offer) (Amendment) Regulations, 2026. The changes modernise the RIO framework, update Significant Market Power assessment and replace older SDCA/LDCA routing concepts with Licence Service Area-based routing. The regulations are notified to take effect from 1 January 2027.
key_facts: The rules update publication and modification requirements for Reference Interconnect Offers.
They accommodate IP-based interconnection and Licence Service Area-level points of interconnection.
A graded financial-disincentive framework applies to specified contraventions.
The effective date is 1 January 2027, so the framework was not yet operational on 27 November 2026.
stories.exam_link: TRAI is a statutory regulator established under the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India Act, 1997; interconnection enables traffic exchange between telecom networks.
stories.source_title: TRAI via PIB — RIO Amendment Regulations, 27 November 2026

stories.title: CSIR-CDRI inaugurates combined BSL-3 and ABSL-3 research facility
stories.summary: A Biosafety Level-3 and Animal Biosafety Level-3 facility was inaugurated at CSIR-Central Drug Research Institute in Lucknow. The facility is intended to strengthen research on challenging infectious diseases and support drug-discovery work requiring controlled handling of higher-risk biological agents and infected animal models.
key_facts: The facility is located at CSIR-CDRI, Lucknow.
BSL-3 refers to laboratory containment for work involving agents capable of causing serious disease, including through inhalation exposure.
ABSL-3 applies comparable high-containment practices to animal research.
The official release stated that CDRI has developed 13 marketed drugs, licensed more than 80 process technologies and filed over 1,000 patents.
stories.exam_link: CSIR is an autonomous scientific and industrial research organisation under the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, Ministry of Science and Technology.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Science and Technology — CSIR-CDRI BSL-3/ABSL-3 facility, 27 November 2026

stories.title: National Biodiversity Authority distributes ₹13.76 crore in benefit-sharing funds
stories.summary: The National Biodiversity Authority disbursed ₹13.76 crore in Access and Benefit Sharing contributions across 28 States and four Union Territories. The money came from AYUSH-product manufacturers using medicinal plants and other plant biological resources. Because individual benefit claimers could not be identified through market supply chains, forest cover and medicinal-plant occurrence were used in allocation.
key_facts: The contributions related to three applications covering 234 plant species.
Ten medicinal plants accounted for ₹6.45 crore of the total benefit-sharing amount.
Tamil Nadu received ₹63,03,300 in this distribution.
The NBA reported cumulative ABS collections of ₹278 crore and disbursals of about ₹218.86 crore.
Possible uses include Biodiversity Management Committees, People's Biodiversity Registers, conservation, restoration and sustainable harvesting.
stories.exam_link: The National Biodiversity Authority is a statutory body under the Biological Diversity Act, 2002 and is headquartered in Chennai; ABS is also linked to the Convention on Biological Diversity framework.
stories.source_title: MoEFCC — NBA ABS fund disbursal, 27 November 2026

stories.title: Vindhyagiri delivered as final Project 17A stealth frigate
stories.summary: GRSE delivered Vindhyagiri (Yard 3024) to the Indian Navy in Kolkata, completing delivery of all seven Nilgiri-class Project 17A frigates. Vindhyagiri is the third ship of the class built by GRSE and was delivered after a reported build period of 68 months.
key_facts: Vindhyagiri is the seventh and final Project 17A frigate.
The class was designed by the Indian Navy's Warship Design Bureau.
The frigates use Combined Diesel or Gas propulsion and controllable-pitch propellers.
The project reported 75% indigenous content and participation by more than 200 MSMEs.
All seven ships were delivered within 23 months of the first-of-class delivery on 20 December 2024.
stories.exam_link: Project 17A is the follow-on class to the Project 17 Shivalik-class frigates and combines stealth, multi-mission sensors and anti-surface, anti-air and anti-submarine capabilities.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Defence — Delivery of Vindhyagiri, 27 November 2026

stories.title: Breakthrough achieved in 6.59-km Tunnel-14 on Rishikesh–Karnaprayag railway
stories.summary: Indian Railways achieved the main-tunnel breakthrough of the 6.59-km Tunnel-14 in Rudraprayag district, Uttarakhand. The event joined 4.7 km excavated from the Sumerpur portal with 1.79 km from the Marora portal, marking a construction milestone rather than completion of the entire railway project.
key_facts: A 110-metre triple-track section was excavated through loose soil beneath inhabited areas.
The Marora slope used micropiles, rock bolts and consolidation grouting for stabilisation.
Controlled blasting near settlements was restricted to daytime.
The Rishikesh–Karnaprayag project is intended to improve hill-region connectivity and access for pilgrims and tourists.
stories.exam_link: Rudraprayag is a Himalayan district of Uttarakhand at the confluence associated with the Alaknanda and Mandakini river systems; tunnel construction must account for fragile geology and settlement risk.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Railways — Tunnel-14 breakthrough, 27 November 2026

stories.title: RBI allots ₹75,006 crore in three-day Variable Rate Repo auction
stories.summary: The Reserve Bank of India published the result of a three-day Variable Rate Repo auction conducted under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility. Against a notified amount of ₹75,000 crore, bids totalled ₹1,35,656 crore and RBI allotted ₹75,006 crore, indicating demand for short-term liquidity.
key_facts: The auction tenor was three days.
The cut-off rate was 5.60% and the weighted average rate was 5.66%.
The partial-allotment percentage for bids at the cut-off rate was 0.42%.
A repo operation injects liquidity against eligible collateral, while a reverse repo absorbs liquidity.
stories.exam_link: The Liquidity Adjustment Facility is an RBI operating framework for managing short-term banking-system liquidity and supporting monetary-policy transmission.
stories.source_title: Reserve Bank of India — Result of three-day VRR auction, 27 November 2026

stories.title: Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat campaign completes two years
stories.summary: The Ministry of Women and Child Development marked two years of the Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat campaign, launched on 27 November 2024. The ministry reported that awareness programmes had reached more than 12 crore citizens and that over 42 lakh pledges had been registered across the campaign portal, MyGov and MY Bharat.
key_facts: The campaign portal listed more than 72,000 Child Marriage Prohibition Officers.
A 100-day awareness module runs from 21 October to 21 December 2026.
The campaign focuses on awareness, community participation, timely reporting and support for girls at risk of child marriage.
It complements implementation of the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006.
stories.exam_link: Under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, a child is generally defined for marriage purposes as a male below 21 years or a female below 18 years.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Women and Child Development — Two years of Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat, 27 November 2026

stories.title: Tamil Nadu invites applications for 2026–27 rural women livestock scheme
stories.summary: The Sivaganga district administration announced the application window for Tamil Nadu's 2026–27 scheme providing free cows and goats to rural women under the Animal Husbandry Department. Eligible applicants were directed to use the State scheme portal from 27 November to 17 December 2026; this is an application invitation, not a report of completed distribution.
key_facts: The application period is 27 November–17 December 2026.
Applications are routed through tnahschems.tn.gov.in.
The scheme is implemented through the Tamil Nadu Animal Husbandry Department.
The official district notice identifies rural women as the intended beneficiary group.
stories.exam_link: Animal husbandry is in Entry 15 of the State List, while livestock improvement and rural livelihoods are commonly implemented through State departments and local veterinary networks.
stories.source_title: Sivaganga District, Government of Tamil Nadu — Rural women livestock scheme notice, 27 November 2026

stories.title: Revised Dr Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme offers assistance up to ₹3.50 lakh
stories.summary: The Dr Ambedkar Foundation outlined the revised medical-aid scheme for eligible Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe patients with life-threatening diseases. Applicants with annual family income up to ₹5 lakh may receive assistance up to ₹3.50 lakh, with the sanctioned amount released directly to the treating hospital subject to scheme ceilings.
key_facts: The revised scheme was notified on 2 June 2026.
Covered areas include heart and kidney surgery, dialysis, cancer treatment, brain and spinal surgery, and organ transplantation.
Assistance can cover 100% of the estimated treatment cost subject to the prescribed ceiling.
The Dr Ambedkar Foundation is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
stories.exam_link: Article 46 directs the State to promote the educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and other weaker sections and protect them from social injustice and exploitation.
stories.source_title: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment — Dr Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme, 27 November 2026

mcqs.question: According to the Power Ministry release of 27 November 2026, approximately what share of India's installed power capacity was non-fossil?
mcqs.explanation: The ministry reported total installed capacity of about 563 GW, with more than 55% from non-fossil sources.

mcqs.question: NAVYA 2.0 expands its eligible age group to which range?
mcqs.explanation: The announced second phase widens eligibility from the pilot's 16–18 years to 16–25 years.

mcqs.question: The 2026 TRAI amendment replaces older SDCA/LDCA routing concepts principally with which approach?
mcqs.explanation: TRAI stated that the amendment adopts LSA-based routing suited to present licensing and IP-based networks.

mcqs.question: The newly inaugurated BSL-3/ABSL-3 facility is located at which institution?
mcqs.explanation: The high-containment research facility was inaugurated at CSIR-Central Drug Research Institute in Lucknow.

mcqs.question: The National Biodiversity Authority's ₹13.76 crore distribution was made under which mechanism?
mcqs.explanation: The money represented Access and Benefit Sharing contributions from commercial use of biological resources.

mcqs.question: Which State received ₹63,03,300 in the NBA's reported ABS distribution?
mcqs.explanation: The allocation table in the official release lists Tamil Nadu at ₹63,03,300.

mcqs.question: Vindhyagiri is the seventh and final ship of which Indian Navy project?
mcqs.explanation: Vindhyagiri completes Project 17A, the seven-ship Nilgiri-class stealth-frigate programme.

mcqs.question: What propulsion arrangement is reported for Project 17A frigates?
mcqs.explanation: The ships use CODOG—Combined Diesel or Gas—propulsion with controllable-pitch propellers.

mcqs.question: Tunnel-14, where a 6.59-km breakthrough was achieved, forms part of which railway project?
mcqs.explanation: Tunnel-14 is being built on the Rishikesh–Karnaprayag railway project in Uttarakhand.

mcqs.question: How much was allotted in RBI's three-day Variable Rate Repo auction on 27 November 2026?
mcqs.explanation: RBI allotted ₹75,006 crore; ₹1,35,656 crore was the total amount of bids received.

mcqs.question: A Variable Rate Repo operation generally has what immediate liquidity effect?
mcqs.explanation: A repo supplies short-term funds to eligible counterparties against collateral and therefore injects liquidity.

mcqs.question: Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat was originally launched on which date?
mcqs.explanation: The campaign completed two years on 27 November 2026 after being launched on 27 November 2024.

mcqs.question: Under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, the general minimum marriage age for a male is:
mcqs.explanation: For the Act's definition of child in relation to marriage, a male below 21 and a female below 18 are treated as children.

mcqs.question: What is the closing date announced for Tamil Nadu's 2026–27 rural women livestock-scheme applications?
mcqs.explanation: The Sivaganga district notice gives an application window from 27 November to 17 December 2026.

mcqs.question: Under the revised Dr Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme, the annual family-income ceiling is:
mcqs.explanation: Eligible SC and ST applicants may have annual family income up to ₹5 lakh under the revised scheme.

mcqs.question: Which constitutional provision directs the State to promote the interests of SCs, STs and weaker sections?
mcqs.explanation: Article 46 is a Directive Principle concerning educational and economic interests and protection from social injustice and exploitation.
